```
['run generate_podcast from a script JSON file to produce an MP3 podcast output', 'run tts_node to convert a Script object into parallel audio chunks via Volcengine TTS', 'create text_to_speech call to convert a single text string into MP3 audio bytes', 'run mix_audio to combine a list of audio byte chunks into a single MP3 output', 'create generate_markdown from a Script object to produce a formatted markdown transcript']

```
